bootstrap_unit: seed; all paired differences formed before resampling
calibration_policy: Four separate honest M4 configurations, seed 7 unchanged, one frozen reference per attack; no evaluation data used for fitting
missing_data_policy: No synthetic outcomes for technical errors; null detection latency stays censored and is summarized conditionally on detection. Exact acceptance confirmations and emitter-specific honest-relay harm are not exported.
scope: Evaluation only; no parameter sweep, threshold optimization, engine edits, CTest rerun, commit or push
